journal: Existing ARE fsynced append-only ledger, exact config binding and serialized writer operations
send: Commit sent before invoking writer; write or timeout uncertainty never auto-retries
recovery: Prepared can send; sent waits for correlated response; received can apply; applying and blocked require reconciliation
bridge_snapshot: Pending RPC, IDs, receipts and configuration digest persist; no cross-binding restoration
host_check: Isolated credential-free app-server; initialize/thread-start/inject/read only; turn/start forbidden; rejecting loopback provider
